dataset_spec.name: uci_mi_lethal
dataset_spec.description: UCI Myocardial infarction complications (Krasnoyarsk, 1992-1995; 1700 patients, 111 predictors). Binary in-hospital lethal outcome (LET_IS > 0). Predictors cover history, admission examination, admission ECG, admission laboratory values and treatment up to the third hospital day.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult admitted to the intensive cardiac care unit of a city hospital with an acute myocardial infarction. The record covers the cardiovascular history, the examination and ECG at admission, admission blood tests, and the drugs given by the emergency cardiology team and in the unit during the first three hospital days.
